headline: Foreigners Consistently Buy 10 Stocks as IHSG Falls for 4 Consecutive Days
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.02% to 5,194.14 on Thursday, its fourth straight session of declines. Foreign investors were reported to be buying a group of 10 stocks.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, and foreign flows are an important driver of its moves.
why_moved: The index dropped 1.02% on the session, and the input reports that foreign investors were buying a group of 10 stocks during the decline.
original_headline: Asing Kompak Serok 10 Saham Ini Saat IHSG Merah 4 Hari Beruntun
